title: Validation failures return 422, while the pinned how_to_verify cites 400
evidence: app.py:230,257 return HTTPStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY for validate_book failures; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'. Malformed JSON does return 400 (app.py:182). 422 is an RFC-valid, appropriate code for semantic validation, so R9 is satisfied — noted only for cross-run status-code comparability.
suggestion: None required; behaviour is correct. A stricter grader keying on literal 400 should treat 422 as equivalent.
